scope: Short likelihood-tempered replica-exchange connectivity test; not posterior convergence or calibration

field.metric: Frozen initial physical scalars per ensemble; posterior noise scaled by 1/beta

rescaling.target: Full positive-beta posterior plus real-coordinate Jacobian

prior_replica: Fresh independent standard-Gaussian white and bounded-uniform physical scalars each sweep; base likelihood evaluated for swaps
local_seeds: 2300000 + ensemble*1000000 + replica*10000 + outer_index*10; field +0, scalar +1, rescaling +2; prior white/scalars +0/+1
swaps: After local updates, attempt disjoint adjacent edges with parity=outer_index%2; exchange complete physical states and labels, retain temperature-slot metrics/counters
roundtrip: Labeled walker first visits cold after warmup, then beta=0, then cold; count only measured-window visits; local prior refresh preserves walker label
replay: Ensemble 0: copy at sweep 96; independently resume 16 sweeps; compare full checkpoint, summary and cold retained draws 32..47; do not pool replay
stopping: Stop at fixed budget even if exchange/roundtrip gates fail. No ladder edits, retuning, excluded ensembles or extra sweeps. Any tuning is a separately recorded experiment.
limits: Only beta=1 records are cold posterior draws
This two-ensemble short connectivity test has no posterior Rhat/ESS or coverage success claim
Labels measure walker transport, not unchanged physical configurations
Path-barrier reduction does not certify energy overlap
Serial validation format, not production MPI ensemble checkpointing
